input: Deep clean the fridge and restock shelves

gold.taskTitle: Deep Clean and Restock the Fridge
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to thoroughly clean the inside of their fridge and refill it with food and supplies.

questions.title: How long has it been since the last deep clean?
questions.description: Understanding the current state of the fridge helps gauge how much time and effort will be needed.

questions.title: Do you have cleaning supplies ready at home?
questions.description: Knowing whether supplies like spray cleaner, baking soda, microfiber cloths, or soap are already on hand determines if a supply run is needed first.

questions.title: Will you remove all food before cleaning?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the plan includes a full empty-out or a section-by-section clean, which affects the steps and time required.

questions.title: Do you have a second fridge or cooler to store food temporarily?
questions.description: Determines how to handle perishables safely while the fridge is being cleaned.

questions.title: Are there specific shelves, drawers, or zones to prioritize?
questions.description: Helps focus the plan on the most critical areas, such as the vegetable drawer, door shelves, or meat compartment.

questions.title: Do you have a shopping list ready for restocking?
questions.description: Establishes whether a grocery run is already planned or needs to be built into the task.

questions.title: When do you want this fully completed by?
questions.description: Sets a deadline so the plan can be broken into realistic time blocks and prioritized accordingly.
